remarks: Renovate, rebuild or restore! This is the best in town village location with endless opportunities to customize and renovate. First time on the market since 1970. 101 is currently being offered as the perfect renovation project. See and experience the endless possibilities to create your perfect home.  Currently a 3 bed, 1.5 bath, 1,304 SF ranch home on a 0.19 acre lot.  This opportunity of a home awaits the next visionary to love and adore while creating their new-found 'home sweet home'. If you like home makeover shows and fixer-uppers, then you will love the opportunity to customize this home to your own lifestyle needs.   Discover the preserved past and reimagine the possibilities to design or rebuild your own New Canaan dream home!
